channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: How to Move Treasury Crypto With Super Bridge
item.description: Treasury teams can move crypto between chains by checking the destination, asset and route first, then confirming the transfer and recording it.

item.title: Mayan Bridge: What Happens in a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: Mayan Bridge combines a cross-chain transfer with a swap; learn what happens between networks, what to check in a quote and how to make a first transaction.

item.title: Aptos adds optional encrypted transactions to mainnet
item.description: Aptos has made encrypted transactions optional on mainnet, hiding trade details while validators set block order to make frontrunning and sandwich attacks harder.

item.title: ESMA asks if tokenised collateral can work in EU clearing
item.description: ESMA has opened a call for evidence on tokenised collateral at EU clearing houses, probing whether it can stay liquid and protected during a member default.

item.title: Sui’s Hashi to launch with more than $500M committed
item.description: Sui says Hashi will begin a phased mainnet rollout this month with more than $500 million committed, giving Bitcoin-backed lending markets capital as they open.

item.title: ESMA asks if tokenised collateral can work in EU clearing
item.description: ESMA wants evidence on tokenised assets used as collateral by EU clearing houses, focusing on whether they can be accessed and turned into cash in a default.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users
item.description: Samsung Wallet will add USDC transfers for eligible U.S. Galaxy users in late October, with crypto wallet sends and local currency payouts to bank accounts in 60+ countries.

item.title: ESMA opens review of tokenised collateral at EU clearing houses
item.description: ESMA has opened a call for evidence on tokenised collateral at EU clearing houses, asking how firms could manage liquidity, legal rights and client safeguards.

item.title: Thailand sets Oct. 16 start for bitcoin and ether ETF rules
item.description: Thailand’s SEC issued 11 crypto ETF rules that take effect Oct. 16, allowing bitcoin and ether funds under new custody, trading and investor safeguards.

item.title: ESMA sets January deadline for non-MiCA stablecoin services
item.description: ESMA says EU-authorised crypto firms must block new access to stablecoins outside MiCA, while supervisors have three months to resolve existing customer holdings.

item.title: ESMA sets three-month wind-down for non-MiCA stablecoins
item.description: ESMA says EU-authorized crypto firms must stop services tied to non-MiCA stablecoins, with national regulators given three months to resolve existing holdings.

item.title: FinCEN Withdraws Crypto Wallet and Mixer Proposals
item.description: Treasury withdrew two proposed crypto rules that would have required financial firms to collect records on some wallet and mixer activity, ending those plans.

item.title: syncswap: Should You Swap Tokens or Add Liquidity?
item.description: The right syncswap move depends on whether you need a one-time token exchange or want to place assets in a pool and take on the risks of providing liquidity.

item.title: Payward, Singapore Gulf Bank add 24/7 crypto settlement
item.description: Payward and Singapore Gulf Bank link settlement for 24/7 dollar transfers, letting institutions in eligible markets fund crypto trades beyond bank hours.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, with six slated for $1 million each, after the Senate blocked the crypto market rules bill last month.

item.title: Blast bridge: what Ethereum-to-Blast integrators need to know
item.description: Blast bridge moves ETH and stablecoins from Ethereum to Blast; integrators need to track the source transaction, destination receipt and asset behavior.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, including six with $1 million each, as the crypto industry looks to revive stalled federal market rules after November.

item.title: OKX-ICE venture files plan for 24/7 tokenized stock trading
item.description: OKXICE has told the SEC it plans a 24/7 venue for tokenized shares in more than 60 U.S. companies, using a temporary exemption with investor safeguards.

item.title: Track Bridge Transfers Through Final Settlement
item.description: A bridge transfer is not complete when tokens leave one chain: treasury teams need to match the source burn, destination claim and final wallet receipt.

item.title: Why a bridged token has a different address
item.description: A bridged token often has a new contract because each blockchain needs its own token record; the bridge links that version to the asset held on the source chain.
